newsitem.title: USA: Fina to expand polypropylene capacity.
newsitem.headline: Fina to expand polypropylene capacity.

text.p: Fina Inc said Friday it has begun engineering for a polypropylene production line at LaPorte Tex. that will have the capacity to produce 550 million pounds of the plastic annually by late 1998.

The new production line will expand Fina's total polypropylene production capacity at LaPorte to 2.15 billion pounds per year, said the company, from an expected 1.65 billion pounds at the end of 1997.
Fina said it has contracted Jacobs Engineering and Construction to do detailed engineering design.

Polypropylene is a plastic used in carpets, uphoslstery, packaging,toys, housewares and automotive parts. The company says it LaPorte polypropylene plant is the largest single site polypropylene plant in the world.
